scope: Read-only actual candidate posed-vertex diff and source-skin influence audit. No new sculpt, parameter trial, rendering or runtime changes.
interpretation: Abdomen-dominated vertices are expected only in the local right socket. Their exact spatial/topological extent still needs artist approval; a dominant-bone label alone is not permission to change all abdomen.

A listed other-limb influence or face-normal rotation needs review; it is not automatically an artistic rejection. A depth-only surface reshape can rotate face normals past90degrees while preserving its signed front projection; see normalRotationDiagnostics.
Normal-only adjacent1ring is allowed around the local position mask. Other meshes/limbs/rest must remain unchanged.
This is a posed-space candidate audit, not proof of a final inverse-skinned existing-target bake at all animation times.
